# DeepSpikingNeuralNetworkTraining

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of training multi-layer spiking neural networks with surrogate gradients to achieve high-performance temporal pattern recognition. Enables deep neuromorphic models to be embedded in network switches/routers, allowing complex in-network data processing without cloud offloading.
